Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle attempted to
change lanes to the right. Driver 2 was operating a vheicle in the rihgt lane, and the two vehicles made contact along
their adjacent sides during the lane change. Officers arrived and observed that the damage to both vehicles was
consistent with the reported sideswipe, with scrape marks and displaced trim running along the right rear quarter
panel of Driver 1's vehicle and matching contact on Driver 2's left side. No earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle was
known to officers or noted during the inspection. Driver 1 was identified as the named insured on the policy for the
vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck strain and stated that the impact jolted their head and upper body forward and back. A
Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both responding officers and a second party
on scene confirmed that presence. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reoprted details, although
no independent witnesses to the collision were located. The reported injury appeared to match the direction and force
of the impact as observed at the scene.

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any

- "reason": one short sentence.
